name: WHO emergencies
summary: WHO's Bundibugyo Ebola emergency of international concern, declared 17 May, remains in force; no new PHEIC to 12 Nov
state: WHO declared the Bundibugyo Ebola epidemic a public health emergency of international concern on 17 May; its Emergency Committee last issued temporary recommendations on 24 Aug, and the WHO Director-General spoke on the outbreak on 11 Nov (WHO). ECDC's 6 Nov update confirms the PHEIC remains in effect. Searches to 12 Nov found no new PHEIC in the past 30 days and no pandemic emergency, so the level stays Watch.
for_you: Travellers to DR Congo and neighbouring countries face entry screening and health checks. Follow FCDO travel advice and NHS guidance on symptoms after travel; WHO's temporary recommendations advise against general travel or trade bans.
rubric_hit: A PHEIC in effect (Bundibugyo Ebola, declared 17 May) = Watch; no new PHEIC in the past 30 days

rubric.alert: A new PHEIC declared in the past 30 days, or a pandemic emergency declared.
rubric.watch: A PHEIC in effect, or an IHR Emergency Committee convened.
rubric.normal: No PHEIC in effect other than long-running polio.
